content.text:
I fitted the RMA regression of width on length for L1 and wrote `answer.json`. The slope is 0.8266909894368555, the intercept is -0.21091768985049342, and n is 38.

Two of the 40 L1 specimens (rows 5 and 22) have a length but no width, so they were left out. I fitted on the other 38. I computed the slope as sd(y)/sd(x), with the sign taken from the correlation, which is positive here. I computed the intercept as mean(y) − slope × mean(x). `answer.json` lists both exclusions and this assumption.

I didn't look for outliers in L1. The L1 maxima (length 40.26, width 33.5) and minima (17.79, 15.56) looked unremarkable.
